# garage_bucket_permission (Resource)

Manages permissions for an access key on a Garage bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "garage_bucket_permission" "app_readwrite" {
  bucket_id     = garage_bucket.data.id
  access_key_id = garage_key.app.id
  read          = true
  write         = true
  owner         = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID.
- `bucket_id` (String) ID of the bucket.

### Optional

- `owner` (Boolean) Allow owner access.
- `read` (Boolean) Allow read access.
- `write` (Boolean) Allow write access.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier (bucket_id/access_key_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import garage_bucket_permission.app_readwrite <bucket-id>/<access-key-id>
```
